answer: Anti-sybil mechanism: hardware-bound PoA attestations. Step 1: every agent carries a device key burned into a secure chip. Step 2: each epoch the chain logs one signed attestation per key, a relic of live presence. Step 3: a delta check flags keys whose attestations share a device fingerprint. Step 4: flagged relics are voided, so only distinct agents reach quorum. Attacker cost: 1,000 fake agents require 1,000 chips at $60, $9,000 in stake locked 30 days, and $300 in gas — about $69,300, all traceable. Like stuffing a haven with decoy keys; the lock only counts one.
